subject: PO validation cutoff, invoice cadence & conditional rebate structure
messages:
From: Marcy Lang <marcy.lang@novushealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Simon Patel <simon.patel@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO fields + invoice cadence question for enterprise pack

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency and the routing controls. Before we move forward we need to confirm a few procurement constraints so our finance/ops folks can draft the blanket PO. Can you confirm whether Redwood can meet the following?

- Mandatory PO header fields: our ERP requires (PO Number, BU Code, Tax ID, Project Code, and AWB Reference). We need those echoed on every invoice line. Can Redwood map those to your invoice metadata fields?
- Invoice cadence: our standard is fortnightly statements (every 2 weeks). Is Redwood able to produce fortnightly statements (vs. monthly)? If not, can you support a weekly run for one-off ramp periods?
- Net terms: preferred net60. Our standard operations only allow net90 for select vendors. Can Redwood accept net60 on a blanket PO, and if not, what is the earliest exception path?
- Conditional rebate: we want a volume-linked rebate — 8% when consumption exceeds 1.2M tokens/month and a 12% rebate when it exceeds 2.5M tokens/month. This needs to be applied as a monthly credit on the statement. Can you confirm feasibility and whether Redwood requires a minimum price floor for rebate eligibility?

I attached our PO template and a short vendor checklist. If you think finance/legal need to be looped, please cc them. We have a procurement cutoff policy: the PO must be validated by 20th of the month to be effective the following cycle.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can progress the SOW/PO in parallel.

Best,
Marcy Lang
Head of Procurement
Novus Health

Attachments: Novus_PO_Template.pdf (PDF), Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcy Lang <marcy.lang@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question for enterprise pack

Hi Marcy — thanks for laying this out clearly. Looping in Vanessa (Customer Success / Billing) and Karthik (Sales Ops / Contracts) who will own the nitty-gritty. Quick responses below and next steps at the bottom.

- PO header mapping: Yes — we can map ERP fields to invoice metadata. We already support PO Number, BU Code, and Tax ID. Project Code and AWB Reference are custom fields but we can add them as invoice-level tags; I’ve asked Billing to confirm the exact label names we’ll print.
- Invoice cadence: Standard is monthly, but we can make a fortnightly statement run as an exception for onboarding/ramp for the first 3 months. Weekly runs are possible but incur an operational surcharge — Vanessa will confirm exact fee.
- Net terms: Our standard enterprise offering is net30 or net45 on hosted plans. For Dedicated/Private we can support net60 with an approved credit check and a commitment tier. Net90 is rare but not impossible with prepayment or a letter of credit. Karthik — can you share the internal approval path for net60 and the timeline?
- Conditional rebate: We can support monthly consumption credits. We typically pair rebates with a minimum committed spend (price floor) so credits don’t create negative unit economics on low utilization. Vanessa — our recommended approach is a tiered rebate with a minimum effective monthly spend; I’ve attached the current pricing tier workbook for reference.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa to confirm surcharge and format for fortnightly/weekly runs and confirm invoice field labels.
2) Karthik to note finance approval path for net60 exception and required docs (credit app, POC).
3) I’ll draft an addendum language for the conditional rebate and minimum price floor and circulate for quick review.

Target: If we can agree on mapping + cadence by EOD 5/17, please confirm and we’ll generate an addendum + SOW revision to attach to the blanket PO.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Account Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Pricing_Tiers.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcy Lang <marcy.lang@novushealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question for enterprise pack

Marcy — quick follow-up from Billing ops:

- Field mapping: Confirmed. We will echo "PO Number", "BU Code", "Tax ID", and will add two custom tags: "ProjectCode" and "AWBRef" on each invoice line as requested. Please confirm exact spellings/case to avoid ERP mismatches.
- Cadence + fees: Fortnightly statements: supported for first 3 months with no surcharge; ongoing fortnightly cadence will carry a 2.5% billing ops surcharge due to extra run costs. Weekly statements are supported as a short-term ramp option (max 6 weeks) and carry a flat $1,200/week operational fee.
- Credit / net terms: For net60 we require either (a) a signed 12-month commitment for the tier that maps to the net60 threshold, or (b) a completed credit application and an approved company reference. Net90 is possible only with escrow/prepayment or an approved finance exception.
- Rebate mechanics: We can implement the monthly credit as you described. We will require a minimum effective monthly spend (price floor) of $25,000 for rebate eligibility; credits will be applied as a line-item negative on the subsequent statement. Rebate calculations will be gross tokens consumed across all routes for the account for the month.

Please confirm: 1) spelling of ProjectCode and AWBRef; 2) whether Novus is comfortable with $25k price floor; 3) preferred cadence (fortnightly for onboarding -> then monthly). Once confirmed we’ll attach an invoice metadata spec and a sample fortnightly statement to the SOW addendum.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sample_Fortnightly_Statement.pdf

From: Marcy Lang <marcy.lang@novushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Simon Patel <simon.patel@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question for enterprise pack

Tessa/Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround. Confirmations below: 

- ProjectCode (one word, camel case) and AWBRef (all caps) — confirmed.
- Price floor: Novus can accept the $25,000 effective monthly spend floor for rebate eligibility; we'll mark that in procurement.
- Cadence: We will take fortnightly statements for the first 3 months and then move to monthly thereafter.
- Net terms: Novus can sign a 12-month commitment to access net60 provided the commitment level maps to the agreed tier. We’ll start drafting the blanket PO and SOW revision.

Please proceed with the addendum language and SOW update. I’ll share the PO template (attached) to the final doc for validation. If you need a Docusign route for the addendum, we can use our standard procurement signature flow.

Thanks,
Marcy

Attachments included: Novus_PO_Template.pdf, Redwood_SOW_v3.docx

--
Simon Patel
Senior Vendor Manager
Novus Health
